titleStmt.title: Don Alfonso XIII, by the grace of God and the constitution King of Spain, and in his name and during his minority Dona Maria Cristina, Queen Regent of the Kingdom, to the President of the Republic of the United States.

div.head: Don Alfonso XIII, by the grace of God and the constitution King of Spain, and in his name and during his minority Dona Maria Cristina, Queen Regent of the Kingdom, to the President of the Republic of the United States.
div.p: Great and Good Friend: The good political and commercial relations which existed between Spain and the United States having been reestablished, we have decided to select Don José Brunetti y Gayso, Duke of Arcos, Grandee of Spain, Gentleman of the Bedchamber to His Majesty, Knight Grand Cross of the Royal Order of Isabel the Catholic and of Naval Merit, Commander of the Royal and Distinguished Order of Carlos III, etc., to represent us in your Republic in the capacity of our envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary. The special qualities which unite in the Duke of Arcos, his recognized merit, and the knowledge which he possesses of the interests of our two countries make us hope that he will be favorably received by you, and we therefore do not hesitate to request you to give entire faith and credit to all that he may tell you in our name; and wishing you happiness and prosperity to your Republic, we are, great and good friend, your good friend,

closer.dateline: In the Palace at Madrid, May 3, 1899.
